import importlib.util,pathlib,json,hashlib,struct,zlib,io
R=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];OUT=R/'.local/step07-review';E=OUT/'evidence';C=R/'artifacts/.review-round9-ci'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('oracle',OUT/'zip-oracle.py');oracle=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(oracle)
SOURCE='50fd6d84197b8c6d222f139a142ab24c918db0db'
rows=[];negatives=[]
def png_crc(b):
 assert b[:8]==b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n';at=8;names=[]
 while at<len(b):
  n=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,at)[0];assert at+12+n<=len(b);name=b[at+4:at+8];crc=struct.unpack_from('>I',b,at+8+n)[0];assert zlib.crc32(b[at+4:at+8+n])==crc
  names.append(name.decode('ascii'));at+=12+n
 assert at==len(b) and names[-1]=='IEND';return names
for mode in ['production','dev']:
 root=C/'.local/step07/browser'/mode
 ev=json.loads((root/'evidence.json').read_text());assert ev['sourceCommit']==SOURCE and not ev['errors']
 assert not [x for x in ev['consoleMessages'] if x['type']=='error' and '422' not in x['text']]
 for check in ev['pixelChecks']:assert check['actualSha']==check['independentReferenceSha']
 assert len(ev['pixelChecks'])==8
 for label in ['first','second','history']:
  p=root/(label+'-export.zip');b=p.read_bytes();result=oracle.artifact(b);assert result['source']==SOURCE
  files=oracle.parse(b);m=json.loads(files['manifest.json']);canon=json.dumps(m['identity'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()
  assert m['buildId']=='step05-pack-'+SOURCE[:12]+'-'+oracle.sha(canon)[:16]
  for n in ['A1.png','A2.png']:png_crc(files[n])
  dst=E/'archives'/mode/(label+'-export.zip');dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);dst.write_bytes(b)
  if label=='first':assert result['manifestSHA256']==ev['manifestSha'] and oracle.sha(b)==ev['zipSha'] and result['exportBuildId']==ev['exportBuildId']
  rows.append({'path':str(dst.relative_to(OUT)),'originalPath':str(p.relative_to(R)),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':oracle.sha(b),'mode':mode,'label':label,'artifact':result,'PNGChunksCRC':'PASS'})
  # Latest real archive negative checks, independent of the candidate parser.
  directory=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,len(b)-6)[0];end=len(b)-22
  for name,offset,data in [('central-crc',directory+16,bytes([b[directory+16]^1])),('eocd-count',end+8,struct.pack('<HH',9,9)),('local-crc',14,bytes([b[14]^1]))]:
   v=bytearray(b);v[offset:offset+len(data)]=data;v=bytes(v)
   try:oracle.parse(v);accepted=True;error=None
   except Exception as ex:accepted=False;error=str(ex)
   assert not accepted
   bad=E/'archive-negative'/mode/(label+'-'+name+'.zip');bad.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);bad.write_bytes(v)
   negatives.append({'path':str(bad.relative_to(OUT)),'sha256':oracle.sha(v),'bytes':len(v),'pythonAccepted':False,'error':error,'outerBodySHARecomputed':oracle.sha(v)})
 assert (root/'history-export.zip').read_bytes()==(root/'first-export.zip').read_bytes()
(E/'latest-browser-archive-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(source=SOURCE,actualArchives=rows,PNGFilesDecoded=12,historyBytesEqualFirstBothModes=True,canvasIndependentReferenceChecks={'production':8,'dev':8},scope='all original e2e flows, real downloaded ZIP and manifest/Profile/PNG identities; no new 24scene/three-cycle specialization or MZ/art approval'),indent=2)+'\n')
(E/'latest-archive-negative-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(negatives,indent=2)+'\n')
print('six actual archives /12PNG /18 independent corruption rejections verified')
